title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page has no formulas. It is a short transitional remark that closes a subsection (pp. ~668–671) and leads into item 5° on the next page.

On the previous pages Grothendieck tried to define, in the setting of 'variations sur l'équation des lacets', several things:
- a subgroup (G_{ξ,σ})_0 ⊂ G^♮_{ξ,σ}, using a subgroup Z_{ξ,σ} that is functorial and defined by adjoint ('int(l)') conditions;
- the related groups G^♮_{ξ,σ} and M^♮_{ξ,σ}.
These seem to be Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type groups (automorphism or 'symmetry' groups attached to the loop/pentagon-hexagon equations), relative to a quotient 𝔊^♮ of the fundamental group 𝔊.

He had just found a defect. Take the universal case, where 𝔊^♮ = Π_0, and the element l = l_0. Its image in 𝔊/Π_0 is the non-trivial central element. So the automorphism it induces on 𝔊^+/Π_0 is trivial. Hence the hoped-for 'exactness' property, l ∈ L_0 with (int(l),1,1,1) ∈ Z ⇔ l ∈ 𝔊^♮, fails.

This page then concludes along these lines: perhaps it is premature to try to pin these groups down 'as finely as possible'. There may still be fairly gross errors of orientation, which will be corrected by examining particular cases. So he gives up, for now, continuing this line of investigation (a phrase reading roughly 'l'imaginaire diédral/dirigé', uncertain). He will push ahead with the present (provisional) definitions, prepared to come back later and rectify them. They will have to be redone completely together with the constructions of § 48 XI.

The next page (item 5°) indeed proceeds formally. It defines S_0M_{ρ,σ}, M^♮_{ρ,σ}, S_0Γ_{ρ,σ} and Γ_{ρ,σ} as fibre products over γ_{ρ,σ}, together with the attached exact sequences. This page itself serves only as a methodological decision point.
errors: No mathematical content to check. The page records Grothendieck's own admission that the preceding definitions (Z_{ξ,σ}, G^♮_{ξ,σ}) may contain orientation errors and fail an expected exactness property. That failure was shown on the previous page through the central element of 𝔊/Π_0 acting trivially.

ideas.what: Methodological decision: postpone the fine definition of the 'natural' subgroups G^♮, M^♮ and continue with provisional constructions, to be corrected later by examining particular cases and by § 48 XI.

deep.surprise_reason: A purely transitional, self-critical paragraph. It has no new construction or result; it only documents that the definitions of G^♮_{ξ,σ}/M^♮_{ξ,σ} were provisional and meant to be revised in § 48 XI.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 begins '"...ssi fin que possible"' (likely the end of 'aussi fin que possible'); 'encore' is written above the line start as an insertion, as transcribed.
The phrase after 'continuer' is very uncertain. It might read 'l'investigation de l'imaginaire dirigé' rather than 'diédral'; the word looks closer to 'dirigé'/'dirigée'.
'j'avancerai donc là dans ce sens' is uncertain; it may be 'j'irai donc là dans ce sens' or a similar phrase.
The final line reads 'du § 48 XI' (XI overlined, i.e. chapter XI), consistent with the machine transcription.
Page number at the bottom left is 671.
